outcome: Composite neonatal adverse outcome (mechanical ventilation, proven sepsis, brachial plexus palsy, clavicular fracture, skull fracture, other fracture, seizures, hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy, or death)
cohort: 53,285 women with no prior cesarean delivery, term singleton cephalic gestation, and who reached complete dilation
finding: Longer duration of active pushing was associated with increased odds of cesarean delivery and composite neonatal adverse outcome in both nulliparous and parous women.
